releases.displayName: A major free content update is coming to BIOMORPH!

items.text: We've been quietly working on this for a few months and we're really happy to finally talk about it: a major free content update for BIOMORPH is in development at Lucid Dreams Studio. Here's what's coming.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783070/e5917d4a8134441c7e4b4025fa9c012914c9318b.png"]

You told us and we listened. EVERY boss fight is being reworked. We're also doing a general balance pass on the game: difficulty, combat arenas, player and monster controls, monster behavior. Don't worry, the accessibility options are still there to tune the game to your needs.
A new place to explore, built to put your navigation skills to the test. Some residents of Dustborough were taken prisoner there. What's really hiding behind this place is up to you to find out.
Want to know how good you really are in a fight? A certain hunter in Blightmoor should be able to help you with that.
BIOMORPH will be ported to Steam macOS, the Apple App Store (macOS), and Xbox on PC with Xbox Play Anywhere support.
Spanish, Traditional Chinese, and German are being added to the game.
All of it free for everyone who already owns BIOMORPH. The update is planned for early 2027. We can't wait to show you more before then. Stay tuned!
Fixed a rare crash that could happen upon Harlo's death;
Fixed an issue where multiple options could be toggled at the same time in the settings screen;
Fixed an issue where the resolution settings were not defaulting to the highest available refresh rate;
Fixed an issue where VSync and FPS capping could both be active at the same time.
Harlo will not be falling anymore until the game with Hornet releases, as it is now released.
Fixed an issue where controller button remapping did not apply correctly.
Fixed an issue where the screenshot map markers would not be saved properly.
Adjusted the economy to align with recent teleport system updates.
Increased the maximum map screenshot pins from 20 to 100.
Reduced input lag.
Resolved a rare soft lock in the Athenaeum area.
Added full Russian localization.
Misc animation bug fixes.

You can now change your Biomorph loadout from any location, not just at S.A.F.E. We finally implemented this much-requested quality-of-life improvement to enhance the player experience. Endgame content is now significantly more enjoyable.
Press the R stick to instantly access a new quick map menu.
Optimizations to improve performance of AI, physics and rendering.
Updated game engine to Unity 6000.0.
Added a loading screen animation.
Resolved a rare crash linked to the particle system.
Fixed various visual glitches for a cleaner look.
Fixed an issue with the "Keep Falling Down" popup when we return to last SAFE or Title Screen.
Added safeguard for the beacon 4 flashback where Kleio could not be spawned when we start the cutscene.
Fixed a bug where the letter-tapper achievement was not given in a specific situation.
Fixed multiple game crashes.
Added Japanese localization for broader accessibility.
Complete rework of the S.A.F.E. upgrade system to enhance user experience.
All rooms now include landmark representations on the map for easier navigation.
Optimization pass on multiple systems for better performance.
Enhanced UI performance and responsiveness.
Flipping between UI tabs in the game menu is now faster.
Updated UI icons to improve clarity and resolve blurriness.
Modified the thumbstick icon for Xbox controllers for better accuracy.
Fixed an exploit involving the Thogwar biomorph during the Sentinel Complex boss fight.
Added initial loading screen feedback to improve user experience.
Resolved a rare crash occurring with the Dash Gateway mechanic.
Fixed a rare crash involving Dustborough biomorphs.
Fixed an audio bug preventing music from restarting after dying in the Core.
Fixed an audio bug preventing music from playing in Blightmoor.
Addressed an issue where some quest markers were not updating correctly.
Added Brazilian Portuguese localization.
Enhanced VFX and particle system optimizations to boost overall game performance.
Optimized animators, animations, and Spine for improved performance.
Increased button sizes in the UI for better accessibility, especially on Steam Deck.
Added a new low health animation to the HUD.
Blood decals now use a stencil shader for more efficient display.
Fixed the default language selector issue.
Fixed particle transition issues when teleporting and switching biomorph forms.
Resolved a transition pop issue between the splash screen and title screen.
Corrected the SAFE icon not updating on the minimap after an upgrade.
Fixed a bug where the Barb Drizzle pushback effect wasn't functioning correctly in water.
Pain Legion can now be effectively used in water.
Fixed Jawfish attack direction inconsistencies when exiting water.
Added new input requests for Jawfish up and up-front attacks.
Resolved an issue where Jawfish bubbles and out-of-water VFX played incorrectly after respawn damage.
Fixed Sentinel Complex destructible area VFX not displaying as intended.
Fixed Muttler front attack animation, which now correctly plays on the base layer.

BIOMORPH is now Steam Deck Verified! The game has been running smoothly on the Steam Deck, thanks to the performance optimizations introduced in patch 1.5. Now, we're proud to announce that it's fully verified. Enjoy!
Controller glyphs are now bigger and easier to read in the game text on the Steam Deck.
Removed full screen exclusive support as there was a bug with the Unity/Steam OS interaction on the Steam Deck.
This update introduces Simplified Chinese localization and aims to enhance game performance on older devices.
Added Simplified Chinese localization.
Increased text size for improved visibility on the Steam Deck.
Optimized memory usage by compressing textures.
Optimized memory usage for NPC portraits, now loaded on demand.
Added FPS Counter option in the Video menu.
Fixed a bug where the “Cool Guys Don't Look at Explosions” achievement was not unlocked when starting the full game with a save from the demo.
Fixed crash when exiting the game with Alt-F4.
Fixed draw order bug on the upgrade device.
Fixed memory fragmentation caused by switching rooms repeatedly.
Accessibility: Introduced a new section within the Pause Menu specifically for accessibility settings.
Accessibility: Added option to disable losing money on death.
Accessibility: Added a game-wide option to increase damage output to help players in combat.
Accessibility: Added a game-wide defense enhancement option to reduce incoming damage.
FPS Limit Options: Introduced adjustable frame rate limits with settings for 30, 60, 120, 144, 240 FPS, and an unlimited option.
Menu Navigation Improvement: Enhanced menu navigation to automatically return to the last visited screen upon reopening the menu.
Quit Game Confirmation: Added a confirmation step for quitting the game to prevent accidental exits.
Return to Title Confirmation: Added a confirmation step before returning to the title screen to prevent accidental exits.
Alarm VFX: Fixed a bug where alarm visual effects would remain active when re-entering the Core.
Balance: Reduced the damage output from Gorgerzer to improve gameplay balance.
Biomorph: The progress value in the menu is now correctly capped.
Biomorph: Addressed an issue where Muttler's dash up attack could become stuck.
Biomorph: Corrected the damage output for Fubirang at rank 2.
Biomorph: Fixed a bug causing Parasling to lose charges at rank 3.
Camera Shake: Resolved an issue where the camera would continue shaking after returning to the title screen.
Chips: Fixed the Ferrox Specter chip to ensure it triggers an additional bounce at rank 3.
Dialogue: Fixed a bug causing infinite dialogue triggers with certain NPCs.
Dustborough DNA Door: Fixed an issue preventing the DNA door in Dustborough from unlocking correctly.
Falling Ground: Fixed an issue where interactions would not trigger correctly while attacking.
Map: Added a missing Aberror to the Sentinel Complex's golden room conditions.
Memento: Resolved an issue where the Positive Solenoid Memento was not functioning as intended when used with a Ferrox Field chip to prevent damage.
Menu: Resolved an issue where the controller remap option was not being correctly disabled when no controller is connected.
Out of Bounds: Addressed an out-of-bounds error occurring when returning to the title screen and reloading a game.
Respawn: Corrected the respawn position of Oddwing to prevent spawning under spike pits.
Scargatos: Added missing Scargatos in Mémé's house that were not appearing as intended.
Balance: Increased by 0.5 sec invulnerability frames after damage.
Fixed a possible crash with sentinels in the Forbidden Plains. This one was pretty nasty. Thanks to DrStein for the help!
Fixed Feel One’s Way quest flow if you previously found another letter tapper.
Fixed missing Jawfish from BIOMORPH progression in Sentinel Complex.
Fixed possible exceptions in Ferrox Barriox AI.
Aberror punches no longer destroy the big doors in Dustborough.
Added end game flag in SpeedrunHandler.
Fixed Free Hand quest completion bug.
Fixed an issue where maps were not being revealed when using a map pillar in Mezzo Skyway and Forbidden Plains.
Fixed tunnels height in Dunes of Time to prevent the Oddwing from entering.
Fixed code exceptions in the material override system.
Fixed code exceptions in the Roltys AI.
Added a SpeedrunHandler component that includes flags for bosses and abilities.
Added skip option for the Credits Screen.
Added additional landmarks on the Sentinel Complex and Forbidden Plains maps to improve navigation.
Fixed a case where the Restorer blueprint is in your inventory and you can’t see it in Qody’s shop.
Fixed a room in Dustborough where it was set to golden even if a quest reward was not given.
Fixed a bug with the Diligent Devout portrait.
FIxed names of some NPC in the French version of the game.
Fixed a soft lock in Baro Excavation.
Fixed an issue where Harlo was getting stuck due to collision with a geyser.
Fixed Toroth interaction with switch in Dunes of Time.
Fixed an issue where the Dustborough Climber's projectile was incorrectly breaking walls from the unintended side.
Fixed crash on Quit to Desktop.

BIOMORPH has been on the market for nearly a week, and we're excited to bring you a series of quality of life improvements and bug fixes. Before anything else, we want to express our profound gratitude for the fantastic response to the game. Witnessing your support and feedback over these past 6 days has been incredible. Now, without any more delay, let's dive into the details of patch 1.1.
It is now possible to quit to desktop from the pause screen.
Added option to disable camera shake from the pause screen.
Added option to return to the last S.A.F.E. from the pause screen.
Added sprint on Harlo and Biomorph forms by holding the dodge button.

Added Screenshot Pin ability in the inventory screen with description on how to use the feature. Screenshot pinning on the map screen was underused and people often didn’t even know the feature existed.
The Architect will now give you hints about where to find building blueprints.
Blueprints for community spaces now look different from those for buildings, making them easier to tell apart.
Save games from the demo can now be used in the full game.
Added additional landmarks on the Sentinel Complex map to improve navigation.
Fixed a case where the Force of Nature achievement would not unlock.
Fixed a case where the Archaeo Afficionado achievement would not unlock.
Fixed a case where the Harlo the Builder achievement would not unlock.
Fixed some typos in French.
Fixed multiple soft locks.
Fixed multiple golden room conditions.

Attention BIOMORPH enthusiasts! Our team recently attended PAX West, and we're thrilled to share our experience and some exciting news. During the event, attendees got an exclusive sneak-peek at the enhanced version of the BIOMORPH demo, now boasting a highly-anticipated feature - the BIOMORPH Arsenal.

With the BIOMORPH Arsenal, players can now freely transform into any biomorphed creature they've previously encountered, allowing for a deeper and more dynamic gameplay experience. Once players biomorph into a specific creature a set number of times, that creature becomes available for selection in their arsenal. Players can equip up to four distinct creatures, paving the way for thrilling monster-versus-monster battles and unlocking new avenues for exploration and discovery.

So now that PAX is over, we are giving you this new build to try out. We're eager to hear your thoughts on this update! Join the conversation on the Steam discussion board or connect with us directly on our Discord server. Happy gaming!
Introducing the BIOMORPH Arsenal: Transform freely into any creature you've previously biomorphed into!
Discover updated hidden secrets within the demo (can you find the scargato?).
Enhanced the Toroth's attack for a more satisfying experience.
Revised and updated all text and dialogues in the teaser.

items.text: Hello Dreamers, we just pushed Update #1 for the Teaser Demo!
We added some new content to the build, fixed some issues and added a few requested features, such as being able to skip the cutscenes! You can find below what is new in this update!
Added support for the Steam Deck!
Expanded the map that you can explore. The original layout was pretty straight-forward (it's the first zone and tutorial), but we added hidden rooms for more exploration. Can you find them?
Added a stats screen at the end of the demo to display how much of the demo you completed. Did you miss any secrets during your playthrough? You'll find out at the end of the demo!
It is now possible to skip cutscenes and conversations.
It is now possible to pogo jump enemies using down + jump button.
It is now possible to remap the Pause and Menu keyboard keys.
Updated boss battle music.
Modified impact VFX for better visibility.
Enemies pushback has been modified.
Healing efficiency has been increased.
A quick reminder that we have a Kickstarter coming soon! You can head over here to be notified when the campaign goes live:
If you love our project, spread the word! That's the best way to help us out!
